sources.title: GitHub - ornith-ai/Ornith-1 · GitHub
sources.snippet: Ornith-1.0 ships as a dense 9B model plus two Mixture-of-Experts models (35B, 397B). All checkpoints expose the same OpenAI-compatible interface and support a 256K (262,144-token) context window; the dense 9B fits on a single 80GB GPU, while the MoE checkpoints are sharded across a multi-GPU node with tensor parallelism.

sources.title: Ornith-1.0-35B: The MoE Model That Runs Like 3B, Thinks Like 27B
sources.snippet: The Bottom Line Ornith-1.0-35B is the kind of model that makes you rethink the parameter count arms race. 35B total parameters. 3B active per token. Near-27B dense quality on coding and tool use. Runs on consumer hardware. No special serving stack needed. For local AI on a MacBook, this is the sweet spot.
